sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your counter-offer. It is always a pleasure to work with your valued house, and we have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our main proposal is a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We are willing to extend the contract term to 24 months to provide you with long-term stability, but we must maintain our 30-day payment terms. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €51.80 per unit, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

We take great pride in our traditional craftsmanship and look forward to continuing our long standing partnership with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

Our family foundry has always valued our long-standing partnership, and it is in this spirit of mutual trust that we recently reviewed our position. In our previous discussions, we have already made a significant concession to accommodate your request for 60-day payment terms and a 24-month contract at €52.20. 

For clarity, our current offer remains a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

We kindly ask you to review your figures so we can conclude this negotiation constructively and continue our shared work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
